summary: This Form 6-K by Mesoblast Limited is a routine quarterly report (Appendix 4C) submitted to the Australian Securities Exchange, covering the quarter ended March 31, 2026. It summarizes financial and operational highlights, including Ryoncil revenues, cash position, patient recruitment for a phase 3 trial, and an exclusive license for CAR technology. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) is detailed; the license is a minor collaboration. The filing is a standard operational update without specific deal terms or a board recommendation regarding a corporate event.
